hooks.command: r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; if [ -z "$r" ]; then r="${PWD%%/node_modules/*}"; while [ ! -x "$r/node_modules/.bin/engrenage-hook" ] && [ ! -f "$r/bin/engrenage-hook/executable.ts" ] && [ ! -e "$r/.git" ] && [ ! -f "$r/pnpm-workspace.yaml" ] && [ "$r" != / ]; do r="$(dirname -- "$r")"; done; fi; cd -- "$r" || exit 0; if [ -x node_modules/.bin/engrenage-hook ]; then exec node_modules/.bin/engrenage-hook codex PreToolUse; fi; if [ -f bin/engrenage-hook/executable.ts ]; then exec node bin/engrenage-hook/executable.ts codex PreToolUse; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"engrenage hooks are off: engrenage-hook is not installed in this project; run pnpm install"}'

r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; if [ -z "$r" ]; then r="${PWD%%/node_modules/*}"; while [ ! -x "$r/node_modules/.bin/engrenage-hook" ] && [ ! -f "$r/bin/engrenage-hook/executable.ts" ] && [ ! -e "$r/.git" ] && [ ! -f "$r/pnpm-workspace.yaml" ] && [ "$r" != / ]; do r="$(dirname -- "$r")"; done; fi; cd -- "$r" || exit 0; if [ -x node_modules/.bin/engrenage-hook ]; then exec node_modules/.bin/engrenage-hook codex SubagentStop; fi; if [ -f bin/engrenage-hook/executable.ts ]; then exec node bin/engrenage-hook/executable.ts codex SubagentStop; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"engrenage hooks are off: engrenage-hook is not installed in this project; run pnpm install"}'
